primarySale.note: feeBps is now per-voucher (signed), not a contract field

roles.note: Testnet refresh: roles default to the deployer EOA EXCEPT the deployer is NOT a TRWI MINTER (minting only via RegenPrimarySale). Set ADMIN_MULTISIG/SIGNER_ADDR/ATTESTER_ADDR/UPGRADER_ADDR/PAUSER_ADDR/FEE_RECIPIENT envs + RENOUNCE_DEPLOYER_ADMIN before mainnet.

note: v3 hardened (security/gas audit, docs/AUDIT.md) supersedes v2. Changes affecting integrators: REBAZ is capped (ERC20Capped); the EIP-712 Voucher gained a `feeBps` field (uint96, after royaltyBps, before nonce) so VOUCHER_TYPEHASH changed; all contracts are Pausable; TRWIStaking adds emergencyUnstake and uses a reward-index accumulator; TRWI setURI removed (metadata immutable). Off-chain signer + frontend EIP-712 types MUST include feeBps or redeem reverts BadSignature.
